program_intro.name: Meet the program
program_intro.subject: Move more, on your schedule
program_intro.headline: A fitness program that fits your week
program_intro.body: Short guided workouts, simple weekly goals and a community to keep you going. Register today and start whenever you're ready.
program_intro.highlight: Guided workouts, weekly plans and support from people working toward the same goals.

success_story.name: Member story
success_story.subject: How Sam found a routine that stuck
success_story.headline: Sam started with ten minutes a day
success_story.body: Sam is a fictional member. Their story shows how small sessions can become a regular routine. Yours can start when you register.
success_story.highlight: Choose sessions that suit your week, then build at your own pace.

free_trial.name: 30-day free trial
free_trial.subject: Try the fitness program free for 30 days
free_trial.headline: Your first 30 days are on us
free_trial.body: Get every workout and weekly plan during your trial. Register now to begin, and cancel at any time.
free_trial.highlight: Full access to the program during your trial. Cancel at any time.

coach_consult.name: Free coach session
coach_consult.subject: Plan your first month with a coach
coach_consult.headline: Get a plan built around you
coach_consult.body: Register for the program and book a free 15-minute session with a fitness coach to set goals that suit your week.
coach_consult.highlight: Talk through your schedule and your goals, then leave with a simple plan for your first month.

onboarding_welcome.name: Welcome and first workout
onboarding_welcome.subject: Welcome to the program
onboarding_welcome.headline: You're in. Here's your first workout
onboarding_welcome.body: Thanks for registering. Start with a ten-minute session whenever you're ready.
onboarding_welcome.highlight: Try two or three short sessions, then choose what you'd like to do more of.
